descriptors.concept_name: Remeasurements of the net defined benefit liability (asset)
descriptors.definition: Remeasurements of the net defined benefit liability or asset comprise actuarial gains and losses, the return on plan assets excluding amounts included in net interest, and changes in the effect of the asset ceiling excluding net interest amounts. Actuarial gains and losses arise from changes in actuarial assumptions and experience adjustments in measuring the defined benefit obligation.
inclusion: Actuarial gains and losses from assumption changes
Experience adjustments
Return on plan assets excluding net interest components
Changes in asset ceiling effect excluding net interest
exclusion: Net interest on net defined benefit liability
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from past service costs which stem from plan amendments or curtailments rather than demographic or financial assumption variances.

descriptors.definition: Presentation standards for post-employment benefits govern criteria for offsetting assets and liabilities across different plans and dictate adherence to general presentation frameworks. An entity offsets plan assets against liabilities only when it holds a legally enforceable right to use a surplus to settle obligations and intends to settle net or realize simultaneously.
inclusion: Criteria for offsetting assets and liabilities of separate plans
General presentation guidelines via other standards
exclusion: Mandatory strict bifurcation of current and non-current portions by this standard alone
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from disclosure obligations as it governs the face financial statement positioning and offsetting rules.

descriptors.definition: Plan assets and liabilities can be offset if and only if the entity possesses a legally enforceable right to use a surplus in one plan to settle another and intends to settle on a net basis or simultaneously realize and settle. These criteria align with the framework established for financial instruments.
inclusion: Offsetting asset relating to one plan against liability of another under strict conditions
exclusion: Offsetting lacking simultaneous realization or net settlement intent
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from general presentation since it imposes strict legal and operational prerequisites before balances can be netted.

descriptors.definition: The standard leaves the separation of current and non-current portions of post-employment benefit assets and liabilities unspecified. Entities determine financial statement presentation categories by applying broader accounting presentation standards.
inclusion: Deferral to general presentation standards for classifying employee benefit balances
exclusion: Explicit standard-prescribed formulas for splitting benefit assets into current buckets
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from explicit calculation rules since the standard intentionally omits a mandatory classification format.

descriptors.definition: The standard does not mandate a specific presentation format for current service cost and net interest cost components of defined benefit liabilities. Entities present these specific cost elements following general financial statement presentation standards.
inclusion: Application of general presentation standards to service and interest cost components
exclusion: Prescriptive sub-classifications mandated directly by the employee benefits standard
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from measurement rules because it governs how recognized cost components appear in financial statements.

descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose information enabling financial statement users to evaluate the nature of defined benefit plans and the financial effects of changes during the period. Required disclosures cover plan characteristics, associated risks, and potential impacts on future cash flows.
inclusion: Evaluations of plan nature and financial effect
Explanations of plan characteristics and associated risks
exclusion: Unrelated general operational disclosures outside the scope of employee benefit liabilities
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from recognition and measurement requirements as it focuses entirely on informative note disclosures for statement users.

descriptors.definition: Entities must provide disclosures explaining plan characteristics, associated risks, and the amounts recognized in financial statements arising from defined benefit plans. Additional supplemental details must be given if standard disclosures are insufficient to meet user evaluation objectives.
inclusion: Explanations of plan characteristics and risk concentrations
Supplemental analyses of defined benefit obligations
exclusion: Omission of details when standard disclosures fail to meet user evaluation needs
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from specific numerical reconciliations by serving as qualitative and contextual background for plan obligations.

descriptors.concept_name: Characteristics Of Defined Benefit Plans And Risks Associated With Them
descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose the nature of plan benefits, the operational regulatory framework, governance responsibilities, and unusual plan-specific risks. This includes detailing potential risk concentrations such as heavy asset exposure to specific market classes.
inclusion: Nature of plan benefits
Regulatory framework description and asset ceiling effects
Governance responsibilities and unusual risk concentrations
exclusion: Generic entity-wide business risks unrelated to specific employee benefit plans
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from financial reconciliations because it emphasizes qualitative governance, regulatory structures, and risk profiles.

descriptors.concept_name: Explanation Of Amounts In The Financial Statements
descriptors.definition: Entities must provide comprehensive opening-to-closing reconciliations for net defined benefit liabilities or assets, plan assets, obligations, and asset ceilings. Disclosures must segregate items like current service costs, interest, remeasurements, past service costs, and disaggregate plan assets by quoted market price availability.
inclusion: Opening to closing balance reconciliations for net defined benefit items
Disaggregation of plan assets into quoted and unquoted classes
exclusion: Omission of separate past service cost tracking when permitted alongside simultaneous settlement adjustments
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from plan characteristic descriptions by focusing on quantitative ledger roll-forwards and financial statement line-item movements.

descriptors.concept_name: Amount, Timing And Uncertainty Of Future Cash Flows
descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose a sensitivity analysis for each significant actuarial assumption alongside underlying methods and limitations to indicate future cash flow impacts. Furthermore, disclosures must detail funding arrangements, expected contributions for the next period, and the maturity profile of obligations.
inclusion: Sensitivity analyses for significant actuarial assumptions
Expected contributions for the next annual period
Maturity profile and duration of the defined benefit obligation
exclusion: General corporate cash flow forecasts unrelated to employee benefit plan obligations
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from historical reconciliations by focusing on predictive metrics, future cash flow impacts, and assumption sensitivity.

descriptors.definition: Participating entities in multi-employer defined benefit plans must disclose funding arrangements, potential liabilities for other entities' obligations, and agreed deficit or surplus allocation terms. If accounted for as defined contribution plans due to data limits, specific alternative disclosures regarding deficits and participation levels are required.
inclusion: Funding arrangements and contribution determination methods
Liabilities for other participating entities' obligations
Surplus or deficit allocation terms upon wind-up or withdrawal
exclusion: Standard single-employer detailed asset and obligation reconciliations when sufficient data is absent and treated as defined contribution
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from single-employer plans due to shared risk structures and the need to disclose contingent liabilities involving other participating entities.

descriptors.concept_name: Defined Benefit Plans That Share Risks Between Entities Under Common Control
descriptors.definition: Entities participating in common control defined benefit plans must disclose cost-charging policies, contribution-determining methods, and relevant plan-wide disclosures or cross-references. Disclosures can reference another group entity financial statement if that report separately identifies information and is publicly available.
inclusion: Contractual agreements or policies for charging net defined benefit cost
Policies for determining entity contributions
Cross-referencing group entity statements under specific availability criteria
exclusion: Independent single-entity plans lacking common control risk-sharing arrangements
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from multi-employer plans by focusing on corporate group common control dynamics rather than unrelated participating entities.
